method: Compared each source_sha256 key's Git blob at the checked-commit tree with the same path in observed current Math main; required blob type. Re-read Math main immediately before recording.
limitations: This is an ad hoc source-tree identity observation, not a general verified auditor or a final gate.
It does not independently recompute the receipt's SHA-256 values, authenticate the historical execution, inspect compiled objects, rerun Lean or prove model hypotheses.
Other package paths or later candidate custody changes are not covered.

mode_verification.scope: Historical checked tree and current Math tree.
